intent: A personal assistant is asked to seek reimbursement of a daycare invoice under a dependent-care plan. Counterparties apply their written policies strictly and cannot waive them. Full attainment requires every invoice line to be disbursed and remain unreversed at the end of the ten-week horizon.

rules.terms: A service-date dispute must identify incorrect dates in the claim file and give corrected dates. A signed attestation must keep line count and amounts unchanged, avoid overlap, and use provided dates within coverage. Ask once for clarification if inconsistent. Registered representatives may sign. The supervisor decides from the claim file and does not contact the provider.
